vocabulary.meaning_en: to show or sell a new product for the first time
vocabulary.example: The company will launch its new phone next month.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that a company makes and sells
vocabulary.example: This is our newest product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the first model of a new product
vocabulary.example: We tested the prototype before making a thousand of them.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk that shows and explains something to a group
vocabulary.example: Our presentation is about to begin.

vocabulary.meaning_en: one page of a computer presentation
vocabulary.example: The next slide shows our sales figures.

vocabulary.meaning_en: used to say what material something is
vocabulary.example: The chair is made of wood.

vocabulary.meaning_en: very good, made well
vocabulary.example: We only use high quality materials.

vocabulary.meaning_en: detailed technical descriptions of how something is made
vocabulary.example: The machine was built to the highest specifications.

vocabulary.meaning_en: strong; not easily broken
vocabulary.example: This bag is tough enough to carry books.

vocabulary.meaning_en: lasting a long time
vocabulary.example: These shoes are very durable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that makes a place look nicer
vocabulary.example: Flowers are a nice decoration for a table.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an amount taken off the normal price
vocabulary.example: We offer a 10% discount on large orders.

vocabulary.meaning_en: larger or kinder than usual
vocabulary.example: The company gave us a generous discount.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a promise to return your money if you are not happy
vocabulary.example: All our products come with a money-back guarantee.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to officially ask to buy goods
vocabulary.example: If you place an order today, delivery is free.

vocabulary.meaning_en: completely sure that something is true
vocabulary.example: I'm convinced this product will sell well.

vocabulary.meaning_en: available for people to buy
vocabulary.example: It's the best product on the market.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to accept requests from customers to buy
vocabulary.example: We're taking orders from today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: showing a lot of interest and excitement
vocabulary.example: She sounded enthusiastic about the new design.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to come together around someone
vocabulary.example: Could you all gather round, please?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that buys services or goods from a business
vocabulary.example: Many clients came to the launch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to show or explain something with pictures or examples
vocabulary.example: These slides illustrate how the product works.

vocabulary.meaning_en: covered in mould (old food goes mouldy)
vocabulary.example: Plastic fruit never goes mouldy.

fine_lines.title: made of vs made from
fine_lines.explanation_ar: made of نستخدمها عندما تبقى المادة واضحة في الشيء (طاولة من خشب). made from عندما تتغير المادة فلا تُرى بسهولة (الورق مصنوع من الخشب).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Use 'made of' when you can still see the material (a wooden table). Use 'made from' when the material has changed (paper is made from wood).

examples.sentence: This aubergine is made of plastic.

fine_lines.title: convinced vs convincing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: convinced تصف الشخص المقتنع (I'm convinced). أما convincing فتصف الشيء الذي يُقنع الآخرين (a convincing presentation).
fine_lines.explanation_en: Convinced describes the person who is sure. Convincing describes the thing that makes people sure.

examples.sentence: I'm convinced our clients will love it.
She gave a very convincing presentation.

expressions.phrase: It is made of the highest quality plastic and I'm convinced it's something your business needs.
expressions.meaning_ar: إنه مصنوع من أجود أنواع البلاستيك، وأنا مقتنع بأنه شيء تحتاجه شركتكم.
expressions.meaning_en: It is very good quality and I'm sure you need it.
expressions.example: Our new chair is made of the highest quality materials and I'm convinced it's something your office needs.

expressions.phrase: This product has been designed to the highest specifications. It's tough and durable.
expressions.meaning_ar: صُمّم هذا المنتج وفق أعلى المواصفات. إنه متين ويدوم طويلًا.
expressions.meaning_en: It was designed very carefully; it is strong and lasts a long time.
expressions.example: This laptop has been designed to the highest specifications. It's tough and durable.

expressions.phrase: It is the perfect decoration on any café or restaurant table.
expressions.meaning_ar: إنه الزينة المثالية لأي طاولة في مقهى أو مطعم.
expressions.meaning_en: It looks great on café and restaurant tables.
expressions.example: This lamp is the perfect decoration for any office desk.

expressions.phrase: We can offer you a generous discount. Plus, all our products come with a money-back guarantee.
expressions.meaning_ar: يمكننا أن نقدّم لكم خصمًا سخيًّا، كما أن جميع منتجاتنا مرفقة بضمان استرداد المال.
expressions.meaning_en: We give a big discount and you can get your money back if you're not happy.
expressions.example: If you order more than 500, we can offer you a generous discount. Plus, all our products come with a money-back guarantee.

expressions.phrase: Could you all gather round? Our presentation is about to begin.
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنكم جميعًا التجمّع هنا؟ عرضنا التقديمي على وشك أن يبدأ.
expressions.meaning_en: Please come closer; we are starting now.
expressions.example: Could you all gather round? Our presentation is about to begin.

expressions.phrase: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming to our presentation.
expressions.meaning_ar: سيداتي وسادتي، شكرًا لحضوركم عرضنا التقديمي.
expressions.meaning_en: A formal way to begin a presentation.
expressions.example: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming to our presentation this morning.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to finish a talk.
expressions.example: That's all from me. Thanks for listening.

grammar.title: The passive for describing products: is made of / has been designed
grammar.explanation_ar: عند وصف المنتج نهتم بالمنتج لا بمن صنعه، لذلك نستخدم المبني للمجهول: is/are + التصريف الثالث (It is made of plastic)، وhas/have been + التصريف الثالث للحديث عن عمل اكتمل وأثره باقٍ (It has been designed to the highest specifications).
grammar.explanation_en: When we describe a product, the product is more important than the maker, so we use the passive: is/are + past participle (It is made of plastic), and has/have been + past participle for a finished action with a result now (It has been designed...).
examples: The bottle is made of glass.
This phone has been designed for business users.
All our products are tested in the factory.

grammar.title: Making a sales offer: If you…, we can… / Plus,…
grammar.explanation_ar: لتقديم عرض للعملاء نستخدم: If you + مضارع، we can + فعل. ولإضافة ميزة أخرى نبدأ الجملة بـ Plus بمعنى «إضافةً إلى ذلك».
grammar.explanation_en: To make an offer, use: If you + present simple, we can + verb. To add another good point, start with 'Plus' (= also, in addition).
examples: If you place an order today, we can deliver next week.
If you buy 100, we can give you 15% off.

questions.question: What is a 'prototype'?
choices: the first model of a new product
questions.explanation_en: A prototype is the first model of a product.

questions.question: 'Tough and durable' means…
choices: strong and lasts a long time
questions.explanation_en: Tough = strong; durable = lasts a long time.

questions.question: This product has ___ designed to the highest specifications.
questions.explanation_ar: نقول has been + التصريف الثالث (مبني للمجهول).
questions.explanation_en: Present perfect passive: has been + past participle.

questions.question: The aubergine is made ___ the highest quality plastic.
questions.explanation_ar: made of عندما تبقى المادة ظاهرة.

questions.question: A 'money-back guarantee' is…
choices: a promise to return your money if you're not happy
questions.explanation_ar: ضمان استرداد المال إذا لم تكن راضيًا.
questions.explanation_en: It's a promise to give your money back.

questions.question: What did Anna suggest using the plastic aubergine for?
choices: as a table decoration in cafés and restaurants
questions.explanation_ar: قالت إنه الزينة المثالية لطاولات المقاهي والمطاعم.
questions.explanation_en: She said it is the perfect decoration on café or restaurant tables.

questions.question: I'm ___ it's something your business needs.
questions.explanation_en: 'Convinced' describes the person who is sure.

questions.question: If you place an order for more than 1,000, we ___ offer you a generous discount.
questions.explanation_ar: النمط: If you + مضارع، we can + فعل.
questions.explanation_en: Pattern: If you + present, we can + verb.

questions.question: Which is a good way to start a formal presentation?
choices: Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming.
questions.explanation_ar: Ladies and gentlemen بداية رسمية مهذبة.
questions.explanation_en: 'Ladies and gentlemen, thank you for coming' is formal and polite.

questions.question: Paper is made ___ wood.
questions.explanation_ar: made from لأن الخشب تغيّر شكله ولم يعد ظاهرًا.
questions.explanation_en: 'Made from' - the wood has changed into paper.
